headline: HIGH-GRADE AT 39.5 g/t AuEq AT GOLDEN EYE — Cygnus Metals Posts Final Assays Ahead of Chibougamau Resource Update
snippet: Cygnus Metals (TSXV: CYG) posted final infill drill assays at its Golden Eye copper-gold deposit in Quebec, returning up to 39.5 g/t AuEq over 3m — with multiple holes converting Inferred to Indicated category. An NI 43-101 resource update is imminent; JV partner Alamos Gold (C$23B cap) is co-funding parallel exploration at the nearby Gwillim gold prospect.

headline: JUGGERNAUT MOBILIZES FOR FIRST-EVER DRILL AT BIG ONE — 10,000m Campaign Tests 263 g/t AuEq Surface Hits in Golden Triangle
snippet: Juggernaut Exploration (TSXV: JUGR) has mobilized rigs for its inaugural 10,000m drill program at the fully funded Big One property in BC's Golden Triangle, where surface samples have returned up to 263.70 g/t AuEq from more than 400 mineralized veins exposed over 1 km of vertical relief — none yet tested at depth.

headline: LAHONTAN TARGETS RESOURCE UPDATE IN COMING WEEKS — Santa Fe Geotechnical Drilling Clears Key Permitting Milestone
snippet: Lahontan Gold (OTCQB: LGCXF) completed 2,569m of geotechnical drilling at its Santa Fe gold-silver mine in Nevada, with early results showing minimal groundwater interaction in planned open pits — a key permitting hurdle. An updated NI 43-101 resource estimate is weeks away, followed by a revised PEA in September 2026. The company is funded into 2027.

headline: COPPER MINTS 23 NEW UNICORN MINES — 75 Operations Now Clear $1 Billion Per Year at Record $6.65/lb
snippet: Mining.com's updated analysis shows 75 copper mines now generate over $1 billion per year based on 2025 production data — up 23 from the prior count — as prices hit a record $6.65/lb. AI data centres requiring up to 6% of capital in copper are the latest demand driver layered on top of the EV transition, with JPMorgan forecasting a 330,000-tonne 2026 deficit.

headline: ONLY U.S. RHODIUM RESOURCE CONFIRMED LARGER — Stillwater Critical Posts Co-Product Assays at 10-Mineral Montana Project
snippet: Stillwater Critical Minerals (TSXV: PGE) confirmed widespread rhodium mineralization at co-product grades across Montana's Stillwater West — the only defined rhodium resource in the United States at 115,000 oz. The project hosts 10 U.S.-listed critical minerals and is advancing toward an updated mineral resource estimate targeting a significant increase from the current base.

headline: GOLD MINERS ON TRACK FOR BEST QUARTER EVER — Fifth Straight Record Profit Cycle With All-In Costs Still Below $2,000/oz
snippet: GoldSeek analysis shows major gold miners approaching their fifth consecutive record-profit quarter, with all-in sustaining costs still sub-$2,000/oz against a gold price above $4,500. Despite the gains, miners trade at a persistent discount to the metal — a valuation gap analysts argue must close, making equities the leveraged play on gold's structural bull market.

headline: GOLDMAN SACHS HOLDS $5,400 GOLD TARGET — Analysts Call $4,500 Correction a Buying Zone, Not a Reversal
snippet: Goldman Sachs reiterated its $5,400/oz year-end gold price target despite a 16% pullback from January's $5,589 record. The bank frames the current $4,400–$4,600 band as a structural accumulation zone driven by central bank buying (244 tonnes in Q1 at a record $37 billion) and sustained geopolitical risk.

headline: LITHIUM NEARLY DOUBLES IN Q1 — Battery Carbonate Hits $26,278/Tonne as China VAT Cut Sparks Supply Scramble
snippet: Battery-grade lithium carbonate nearly doubled in Q1 2026 to US$26,278/tonne, driven by Chinese producers front-loading exports ahead of Beijing's April VAT rebate cut on lithium-ion batteries. Speculative buying compounded the move, sending prices to their highest since 2022, though analysts warn elevated volatility persists as inventory data remains murky.

headline: MP MATERIALS BETS $1.25B ON TEXAS MAGNET CAMPUS — '10X' Site to Scale U.S. Rare Earth Output 10-Fold
snippet: MP Materials selected Northlake, Texas as the site of '10X,' a $1.25B+ rare earth magnet manufacturing campus targeting 10,000 metric tonnes/year — a 10-fold increase over its existing Independence facility. Commercial magnet sales from Independence are set to begin H2 2026, establishing North Texas as the fulcrum of America's domestic rare earth supply chain.

headline: SMART MONEY ROTATES INTO COPPER, URANIUM AND RARE EARTHS — Why Institutional Investors Are Ditching Tech for Critical Minerals
snippet: Institutional money is quietly rotating into copper, uranium, and rare earth equities as structural shortfalls collide with a generational rebuild of Western supply chains. The thesis: AI, electrification, and defence spending create non-cyclical, multi-decade demand curves that no amount of recycling or substitution can satisfy at scale before 2030.
